supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.controls: Same universal20 grant, prices, exact fixed-source supply, finite styles/forge and existing SeasonRewards policy. No external purchases or new users.
assumptions.recycling: At season open commit at most50%/100% of cash already in treasury. Reuse remaining cash once; exclude future receipts. Equal boss amounts and closed rank are independent of personal spending. Current contract still counts every payment as emission.
assumptions.accounting: Gross claims include reissued treasury tokens and are the ORIGINAL <=2 acceptance denominator. Fresh release is reported separately and NEVER substitutes for that test. Wallets+retained treasury+burns=fresh release. Recirculation creates neither new token supply nor buyer utility.
assumptions.execution: Treasury transfer/withdrawal/funding is hypothetical and not automatic in deployed contracts. No operator action, new token mint or mainnet support.
assumptions.behavior: 50% style and forge interest among adopters is unmeasured. Bot labels and conditional successful routes are modelling assumptions. No bot is invented as a cosmetic buyer.
assumptions.evidence: Source-backed mechanism comparison, not a demand forecast. 144 simulations are not144 observed people. All failure rows retained.
